Compliance & Certification

Every GEL.IT.UP by GIUP® product is manufactured by Thermitek Ltd / Leeukopf Laboratories — an EU-based manufacturer operating under strict European regulations and internationally recognised standards. Below are the key certifications and regulatory memberships that back every bottle we ship.

Certified & Recognised By
Product Notifications

CPNP Registration

EU Cosmetic Products Notification Portal

Every GEL.IT.UP product is registered on the EU Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) prior to sale, with safety assessments (CPSR) and full Product Information Files (PIF) maintained by our manufacturing partner, as required under Regulation (EC) No 1223/2009.

Certifications

Documented & Verified

Click any certificate below to view an enlarged version.

Bulgarian Chamber of Commerce & Industry

Direct membership in the Bulgarian Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

Bulgarian Cosmetics Association

Membership in the Bulgarian Cosmetics Association.

FDA Compliance Certificate

Certificate demonstrating compliance with FDA regulations for cosmetic products.

Free Sale Certificate

Confirms our gel/gel polish nail products are compliant and freely sold in Bulgaria and the European Community.

GMP Certificate

Certification for manufacturing according to Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) for cosmetics.

ISO 9001:2015

Certification for our manufacturer’s quality management system and in-house laboratory.

Leaping Bunny — Cruelty Free

Cruelty Free International Leaping Bunny approval for cosmetic and personal care products.

SFDA Certificate of Conformity

Certificate of Conformity for export to Saudi Arabia, issued via TÜV Austria on behalf of the Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA).

TPO-Free Compliance

Confirms our gel polish products are TPO-free (Trimethylbenzoyl Diphenylphosphine Oxide-free), independently tested by TÜV Austria.

Packaging

EU PPWR Compliance

Packaging & Waste Regulation (PPWR)

Starting 12 August 2026, the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) applies across all member states. Packaging Declarations of Conformity and material composition labelling for our products are prepared by our manufacturing partner and published here as each format is finalized.
